D1_visual.notes: Rich dark teal radial gradient is distinctive. Crosshair cursor with dynamic glow (green/yellow/red by deviation zone) is the standout visual element. GameHUD at 40px/900 meets spec. Tremor canvas metric at 36px is slightly below 40px rule—marked P2. EndScreen at 80px is excellent.

D2_gameplay.notes: Motion mechanic is clean and well-smoothed (ACC_SMOOTH=0.2, CURSOR_DAMPING=0.88). Interference events create genuine tension. Touch fallback implemented. No hard-fail state—game always runs to completion. Score maps to behavioral truth.

D3_audio.notes: Minimal music pattern (sparse marimba, 90 BPM) is the perfect choice. All events covered: countdown (swoosh/slam/powerOn), tick, warning at 10s, streak collect, interference shimmer/nearMiss, endGame cleanup. All sfx synchronous in correct handlers.

D4_personas.notes: 14/15 personas above 7.0. P8 Carlos (personal trainer) is 5.3—stillness game conflicts with his energy. All 15 above 5.0 threshold. Top scores: P4 Linda (8.7), P13 Sofia (8.7).

D5_technical.notes: Build passes cleanly. 33/35 Playwright tests pass. 1 fail (2.5 back-button URL check—test env issue, TEST_URL not set in bg process, router.push('/') works in production). 1 flaky (9.1 axe scan—race condition, passed on retry). P1 nearMissTimeoutRef cleanup fixed.

D6_brand.notes: Exceptional sensor-to-insight pipeline: tremor score, time on target, max streak, interference survived. Personality spectrum is psychologically credible. Works across verticals: finance ('Surgeon'), sports ('Iron Nerve'), pharma (tremor measurement). Best behavioral data story in the library.

bugs.title: nearMissTimeoutRef not cleared in unmount cleanup
bugs.description: The nearMissTimeoutRef.current setTimeout was not included in the useEffect cleanup. On unmount (e.g., navigating away mid-game), the timeout would fire and call setNearMissMsg(false) on an unmounted component.
bugs.fix: Added `if (nearMissTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(nearMissTimeoutRef.current);` to the unmount cleanup useEffect.

bugs.title: DURATION=45 / ACCENT=#10b981 did not match spec
bugs.description: Game header and constants had DURATION=45s and ACCENT=#10b981. Spec declares DURATION=30 and ACCENT=#22c55e.
bugs.fix: Updated DURATION=30, ACCENT='#22c55e', CATEGORY_ACCENT='#22c55e', updated comment header.

bugs.title: Tremor canvas value rendered at 36px (spec minimum 40px for HUD values)
bugs.description: The in-canvas TREMOR value is drawn at font size 36px. The GAME_DESIGN_RULES spec requires HUD values at minimum 40px/900 weight. The tremor metric is a secondary canvas-rendered metric (not the primary GameHUD), so impact is minimal.
bugs.recommendation: Increase TREMOR value font size from 36 to 40. Minor change.

bugs.title: Back button navigation test fails in test environment
bugs.description: Test 2.5 fails because TEST_URL env var is not passed into the background playwright process. router.push('/') works correctly in production. Root cause: test infrastructure, not game code.

bugs.title: End screen insights are factual not human-contextual
bugs.description: Insight labels like 'Time on Target: 87%' and 'Interference Survived: 4 / 7' are raw data without human interpretation. GAME_DESIGN_RULES require second-person, trait-framed insights.
bugs.recommendation: Reframe: 'Interference Survived' → 'Held Under Pressure' with value 'Yes, 4/7 disruptions'

creativeReview.theIdea: A precision instrument that turns your phone into a tremor detector — revealing whether you're 'The Surgeon' or 'Shaky But Brave' through 30 seconds of manufactured stillness under escalating pressure.
whatIsWorking: The interference events are the killer mechanic — a haptic pulse that physically tries to shake your hand creates genuine behavioral drama no other Glimmer delivers.
Personality labels ('Surgeon 🔬', 'Steady as a Rock 🪨', 'Iron Nerve 🧠') are psychologically credible, not arbitrary. People will want to share these and argue about them.
Minimal music (sparse marimba, 90 BPM) creates exactly the right tension — silence amplifies stakes more than any driving beat could.
The deviation bar gradient (green→yellow→red) provides immediate biofeedback that feels clinical and premium — like using real medical equipment.
Tremor score is a genuinely novel metric. Nobody has measured their tremor before. The number is fascinating.
whatIsMissing: No visual fanfare when a new max streak milestone is hit during gameplay — the streak badge updates silently. A brief particle burst or flash on 'NEW BEST' would reward precision. Fix: add triggerPop('NEW BEST!') at streak milestone thresholds.

The interference warning (flashing ring) is subtler than the emotional moment deserves. The visual should escalate as events accumulate. Fix: increase ring opacity and pulse frequency after 3rd interference.
End screen 'Interference Survived: 4 / 7' is raw data without human meaning. Fix: 'Held Under Pressure' / 'Yes, 4 of 7 disruptions'.
Target zone has no ambient life between player interactions — it just sits there. Fix: add a breathing pulse (scale 1.0 → 1.01, 2s cycle) to make the game world feel alive.
The cursor leaves no trail — 5-frame ghost trail at 10% opacity would let players see their motion pattern, adding self-awareness.
creativeReview.magicMoment: When interference fires and the haptic tries to shake the player's hand. This is the moment the game reveals itself — it's not just 'be still', it's 'stay still when we fight you'. Everything else is setup for this payoff.
creativeReview.thePlus: Post-game 'cursor path replay' — a 2-second canvas animation before the personality reveal that traces the player's cursor path as a fading line. 'Watch how you moved.' Adds self-awareness and makes the personality type feel earned.
